info.name: Part 3 — Charbel Faddoul
info.description: Prepared development collection, not execution evidence. Run folders in order. Set real tokens for all four roles and numeric asset_id/analyst_id. The employee token creates the incident; analyst_id must match analyst_token. Missing-token and outage tests can be performed manually. Configure agreed Part 2 login outcome labels before activity report. Never expose secrets in screenshots. Cleanup deletes only the demo playbook.
